purpose: Discover recurring SmartGlasses coverage signals and turn them into bounded ontology and content-strategy learning without treating videos as product-fact evidence.

schedule.reason: Stay within YouTube API data-refresh requirements while approximating a monthly research cycle.

retention.dedupe_scope: Deduplicate raw video IDs only against the current unexpired snapshot; delete or refresh non-authorized metadata before 30 days.
retention.history: Long-term run receipts retain our request/result counts and a snapshot fingerprint, but no video IDs, channel IDs, titles, descriptions, comments, transcripts, statistics or audiovisual content.

ontology_candidates.label: Required companion device
ontology_candidates.description: Required phone, compute puck, console, adapter or other host device, including compatibility conditions.

ontology_candidates.label: Firmware and software support
ontology_candidates.description: Documented update channel, support commitment and feature dependencies; do not infer future support.

gates.product_fact_evidence: YouTube topic discovery cannot establish product facts; claims still require governed primary or qualified independent evidence.
gates.ontology_promotion: A detected topic remains an expiring signal until independently corroborated; it never activates a field definition or becomes permanent product evidence.
gates.publication: No discovered title, strategy or draft is publication approval.
gates.rights: Do not download video, audio, thumbnails or transcripts. Store no comments or viewer identity.
gates.channel_selection: Candidate channels are recurring results in a bounded query set, not a definitive popularity, quality or endorsement ranking.
